add_audio_to_video: Add an audio track to a video
add_border: Add a border around an image
api_get: GET request to an API (returns JSON)
api_post: POST request to an API with a JSON body
append_file: Append text to the end of a file
check_disk: Check a disk for errors (chkdsk, read-only)
check_port: Check whether a port is open on a host
clean_downloads: Clear old files from Downloads (older than N days)
click_image: Find an image on screen and click it
collage: Combine several images into a collage (horizontal)
collect_files_by_type: Copy all files of one type into a folder
concat_videos: Join two videos one after another
convert_image: Convert an image to another format
convert_video: Convert a video to another format (e.g. mp4)
count_by_type: Count all files by type in a folder
count_lines_of_code: Count lines of code in a project
count_occurrences: Count how many times a substring occurs
create_shortcut: Create a shortcut on the desktop
create_task: Create a scheduled task (run a program at HH:MM)
crop_image: Crop an image (x, y, width, height)
csv_column_sum: Average of several CSV columns by number (column name)
csv_preview: Read a CSV and show the first rows
csv_shape: How many rows and columns in a CSV
csv_to_excel: Create an Excel file from CSV
currency: Exchange rates to ruble/dollar (exchangerate, no key)
delete_dir: Delete a folder with all its contents
detect_faces: Find faces in a photo (how many)
download_file: Download a file from a link
download_image: Download an image from a link
excel_preview: Read an Excel file and show the first rows
excel_sheets: List of sheets in an Excel workbook
excel_sum_column: Sum a numeric Excel column (by letter, e.g. B)
extract_audio: Extract audio from a video (to mp3)
extract_page_links: Extract all links from a page
focus_window: Bring a window to the foreground by title
get_webpage_text: Get the text of a web page (no tags)
hotkey: Hotkey combo (e.g. ctrl c, alt tab)
http_get: HTTP GET — response code and start of body
json_get: Get a value from JSON by key (dotted path a.b.c)
kill_process: Terminate a process by name or PID
last_boot: How long the PC has been running (last boot)
list_dir: List files and folders in a directory
list_processes: List of running processes (top by memory)
local_ip: Local IP address of the PC
locate_on_screen: Find an image on screen and return coordinates
make_excel: Create an Excel file from a table (rows via ;, cells via ,)
make_folders: Create several folders from a list (comma-separated)
make_presentation: Create a PowerPoint presentation (.pptx) from an outline. outline — the plan text: slide titles and bullet points
make_presentation_pdf: Create a presentation as PDF (16:9 slides) from an outline. outline — slide titles and bullets. Use when a PDF presentation is specifically needed
make_qr: Create a QR code with text/link
make_word: Create a Word document with text
merge_text_files: Merge all txt files in a folder into one
mouse_click: Left click at a point (x, y)
mouse_double_click: Double click at a point (x, y)
mouse_drag: Drag the mouse from one point to another
mouse_move: Move the mouse to a point (x, y)
mouse_right_click: Right click at a point (x, y)
number_stats: Mean, median, sum of numbers (comma/space separated)
open_file: Open a file in the default program
open_in_vscode: Open a folder/file in VS Code
open_night_light: Night Light is toggled manually — open settings
open_settings: Open a Windows settings page (e.g. ms-settings:bluetooth)
open_url: Open a link in the browser
organize_by_extension: Sort files into folders by extension
pdf_extract_pages: Extract a page range into a new PDF
pdf_pages: How many pages in a PDF
pdf_rotate: Rotate all pages of a PDF
pdf_split: Split a PDF into separate pages
pdf_to_images: PDF pages → images (via PyMuPDF, if available)
percent_change: By what % X is more/less than Y
percent_of: Percent: how much is X% of Y
pixel_color: Pixel color at a point (x, y)
press_key: Press a key (e.g. enter, esc, f5)
print_file: Print a file on the default printer
python_check: Check the syntax of a Python file
read_qr: Read a QR code from an image
regex_find: Find matches by a regular expression
registry_read: Read a value from the registry
remove_empty_folders: Delete empty folders inside a directory
resolve_host: Resolve the IP address of a domain name
restart_pc: Restart the PC in N seconds
rotate_image: Rotate an image by an angle
run_command: Run a terminal command and return the output
run_python: Run Python code and return the output
scan_ports: Scan common ports on a host
screenshot: Take a screenshot of the whole screen to a file
screenshot_region: Screenshot a region (x, y, width, height)
search_files: Find files by name mask in a folder (recursive)
search_in_files: Find text inside files in a folder
set_env: Set an environment variable (for the user)
set_wallpaper: Set an image as the desktop wallpaper
show_file_numbered: Nicely show file contents with line numbers
shutdown_pc: Shut down the PC in N seconds
site_status: Site status code (is the site alive)
slugify: Make a slug for a URL (latin + hyphens)
speed_video: Change video speed (2.0 = twice as fast)
start_web_server: Start a local web server in a folder
text_diff: Difference between two texts (line by line)
text_similarity: Similarity of two texts in percent
traceroute: Trace the route to a host
trim_video: Cut a video fragment (from HH:MM:SS, duration sec)
video_frame: Frame from a video at a given second
watch_folder: Watch a folder for N seconds and report new files
weather: Weather in a city (via wttr.in, no key)
web_search_results: Web search — find information (across many sites if a Tavily key is set) and return text + sources
wifi_current: Show the current Wi-Fi network and signal
wifi_password: Password of a saved Wi-Fi network (your own)
word_append: Add a paragraph to an existing Word document
word_count: Count words and characters in text
word_count_doc: How many words in a Word document
word_text: Read text from a Word document
wrap_text: Wrap text to a width (line breaks)
